predecessors.name: Viceroyalty of Peru
predecessors.text: Spanish Chile of 1541 without the Peruvian and Charcas north

successors.name: Republic of Chile
successors.text: the Republic of Chile after Chiloe

ledger.x: 1541 (11 June): Pedro de Valdivia is named governor and captain general of New Extremadura.
1550: Concepcion is founded.
1550: the southern cities, Chiloe and Cuyo are drawn Spanish from here.
1598 (21 December): the Disaster of Curalaba begins the general Mapuche uprising.
1599: Santa Cruz de Coya, Valdivia and Angol are lost.
1600: La Imperial is lost.
1602: Villarrica is lost.
1603: Osorno is lost.
1604: Arauco is lost.
1604: the six-year struggle ends with the Bio-Bio as de facto frontier.
1645: Spain begins to re-establish its rule south of Araucania.
1776: Cuyo passes to the Rio de la Plata.
ledger.cpn: Viceroyalty of the Rio de la Plata

ledger.x: 1796: the reestablishment south of Araucania ends.
1810 (18 September): the First Government Junta of Chile.
1814 (2 October): the Disaster of Rancagua.
1817 (12 February): Chacabuco.
1818: independence is declared and the war moves south.
1820: Cochrane takes Valdivia.
1822: the Concepcion region is pacified.
1822: the Concepcion region passes to the republic.
1823: Osorno is dropped from the Spanish shape.
1826: Chiloe falls.

wars.name: Arauco War
wars.outcome: Valdivia's conquest campaigns met Mapuche resistance; the Disaster of Curalaba (21 December 1598) began the Destruction of the Seven Cities (1599-1604), after which the Bio-Bio was the de facto frontier (La Frontera); the war continued sporadically.

wars.name: Chilean War of Independence
wars.outcome: Patria Vieja 1810-1814, Reconquista 1814-1817 (Rancagua), Chacabuco 12 February 1817, independence 12 February 1818, Maipu 5 April 1818, Valdivia 1820, Concepcion pacified 1822, Chiloe 1826.

wars.name: Guerra a Muerte (Concepcion region)
wars.outcome: A guerrilla war in which 'neither the guerillas nor the government soldiers took prisoners'; ended in 1822 with the liquidation of Benavides's band.
